title: The selected count follows search, Select All and Select None
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop's own term is held by five customers, two with "Fleet" in their names, and you tick and untick while searching.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 20 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly five customers: {Customer-A}, {Customer-B}, {Customer-C}, {Customer-D} and {Customer-E}; only {Customer-B} and {Customer-D} have "Fleet" in their names.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-25 N20, they are ZZAUTOTEST DATA-25 Alpha, ZZAUTOTEST DATA-25 Bravo Fleet, ZZAUTOTEST DATA-25 Charlie, ZZAUTOTEST DATA-25 Delta Fleet and ZZAUTOTEST DATA-25 Echo.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Type "fleet" in "Search customers".
  4. Click "Select None".
  5. Clear the search box.
  6. Untick {Customer-A}.
  7. Type "fleet" in "Search customers".
  8. Click "Select All".
  9. Clear the search box.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: "5 selected"; button "Move 5 Customers".
  • Step 3: only {Customer-B} and {Customer-D} are listed; still "5 selected".
  • Step 4: "3 selected" (5 − 2); button "Move 3 Customers".
  • Step 5: all five listed, {Customer-B} and {Customer-D} unticked, "3 selected".
  • Step 6: "2 selected".
  • Step 7: the two Fleet customers are listed.
  • Step 8: "4 selected" (2 + 2); {Customer-A} stays unticked because the search hides it.
  • Step 9: four ticked, {Customer-A} unticked, button "Move 4 Customers".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R2: “The window shows, top to bottom: a "Search customers" box; "Select All" and "Select None" with "{n} selected" on the right; a scrolling list of every customer on the term, A to Z, each with a checkbox; a "Move To" dropdown; and the buttons "Cancel" and "Move {n} Customers" ("Move 1 Customer" when one is selected).”
  • S4-R6: “"Select All" ticks, and "Select None" unticks, every customer the search currently matches, including those not scrolled into view. Customers hidden by the search keep their ticks.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
